title: Hats+ Resource Pack
description: This project adds some hats of my choosing to the game, over pumpkins and other smaller items
body:
# *Adds some hats over the carved pumpkin when re-named*

## Hat Names
 -Careved Pumpkin-
- Train Hat = train hat
- Dor 15 = Hat from meet the robinsons
- Bumblebean = Cursed creature
- Pikachu = Pikachu model from cobblemon
- PikachuShiny = Shiny Pikachu model from cobblemon
- Brendan = Brenedan pokemon hat
- Sonic Monitor = Sonic monitor

These are the important Models i use this on a server with friends and thought some people would like to use them

**WARNING**
Must have Sodium or Optifine to load the models
